items.title: ConocoPhillips (COP) Stock Looks Like A Bargain On Its 184% Run
items.summary: ConocoPhillips stock has delivered very strong long term gains over the past five years, yet the broader valuation checks point to a mixed picture rather than a clear bargain or clear overvaluation at the current price. ConocoPhillips has returned 183.8% over the past five years, which sets a high bar for any further value the share price may offer.
